content.title: Rory McIlroy Masters 2026: Scorecard, leaderboard position for final round at Augusta
content.text: Updated April 12, 2026, 7:52 p.m. ETFollow along with live updates of all the final-round action at the Masters Tournament.Rory McIlroy's third round bordered on disaster, but the defending champion played catchup during the final round of the Masters and held on to become Augusta's back-to-back champ.After a birdie on the third hole, McIlroy notched a double bogey on No. 4 and a bogey on No. 6 to drop off the top of the leaderboard. He went on to birdie four of the next seven holes and climb back into the lead. And though he nearly found water on No. 15 and sliced his drive well into the trees on No. 18, McIlroy was able to survive the drama and win another green jacket.McIlroy looked every bit ready to run away with the second consecutive title after two dominant rounds to start the Masters. Then came the third round, when a double bogey on 11 and a bogey on No. 12 drastically halted a historic run for the golfer.USA TODAY Sports followed Rory McIlroy's final round at the Masters with real-time scoring, shot-by-shot updates and highlights: Masters leaderboard1.
